io.name: z
io.description: Moore output based on present state

functional_summary.overview: Moore FSM. Outputs Y0 (bit 0 of next state) and z are combinational functions of present state y and input x. State transitions occur on posedge clk.
rules: Y0 = 1 iff (y==000 and x==1) or (y==001 and x==0) or (y==010 and x==1) or (y==011 and x==0) or (y==100 and x==0); else Y0 = 0.
z = 1 iff y is 011 or 100; else z = 0.
Outputs are combinational and reflect current y and x; they are sampled after posedge settling.
